cards.text: Freeze decision timestamp, collect separately authored bull, bear, valuation and risk deliverables. Preserve disagreements and identify which evidence would resolve each.
Decision register separates accepted facts, assumptions, missing inputs and blockers. No majority vote or memo treated as approval.
Learn from unresolved blockers, missed countercases and subsequent independently measured thesis outcomes.

A011.critical_failure: Suppressing a material dissent or treating a memo as authorization
A011.challenge_case: Contradictory bull/bear evidence with missing risk approval

cards.text: Compare proposed action to signed mandate, account-specific limits, current authority and revision hash. Default deny on unknown policy.
Report each rule, threshold, observed value and reason. Never infer permission from a favorable thesis.
Track false approvals and false denials against independently adjudicated policy cases.

A012.critical_failure: Unapproved policy or unauthorized leverage accepted
A012.challenge_case: Expired mandate and changed risk limit

cards.text: Decompose objective into dependencies, task budgets, evidence cutoffs and role-specific deliverables. Schedule prerequisites before consumers.
Check every required output has a named owner and no dependency cycle; unresolved tasks stay blocked.
Learn task duration, failure causes and dependency misses without modifying authorization.

A013.critical_failure: Planning an unavailable source as verified or bypassing approval
A013.challenge_case: Incomplete issuer data and constrained budget

cards.text: Resolve exact evidence IDs, filing accession, issuer, timestamp, units and text span. Trace derived figures to originals.
Reject orphan citations, post-cutoff revisions and unsupported numeric claims; distinguish source existence from entailment.
Use reviewed citation failures and independently graded retrieval cases; keep benchmark answers out of memory.

A014.challenge_case: Correct document ID but wrong period and currency

cards.text: Freeze committee packet and preserve every dissent, approval reference and version; write chronological minutes.
Reconcile minutes to actual stage decisions, never invent attendance, vote or signatures.
Learn omissions in decision minutes from verified records, not investment opinions.
Validate contract identifier, exchange, currency, price type, timestamp and session; check bid/ask ordering and missing data.
Report stale or crossed quotes, inconsistent corporate actions and unmatched identifiers. Do not substitute prior close silently.
Track verified feed outages, latency and false quote alarms.

A021.critical_failure: Using stale or partial quote as executable
A021.challenge_case: Delayed IEX quote with stale last trade

cards.text: Normalize XBRL concepts, contexts, currencies, fiscal dates and amendments; reconcile annual, quarterly and YTD series.
Tie statements where available; avoid subtracting incomparable YTD periods, mixing units or restated facts before publication.
Learn issuer-specific tag mappings only after reviewed reconciliations.

A022.critical_failure: Mixing quarter and YTD or using future restatement

cards.text: Find original filing or issuer release, timestamp first publication and distinguish rumor, confirmation, effective date and correction.
Record event taxonomy and independent source lineage; never infer credibility from repeated headlines.
Learn event misclassification and reporting lag from corrected primary sources.

A023.challenge_case: Conflicting news and later issuer denial

cards.text: Join providers by immutable instrument identity, session, currency, adjustment and field definition; compare revisions separately.
Classify breaks by identity, timing, split, currency or missing fields; no automatic averaging of conflicts.
Learn verified break-resolution rules and provider-specific latency patterns.

A024.critical_failure: Treating correlated providers as independent proof

cards.text: Inventory data origins, access grants, retention and cloud rights; trace each derived artifact to its source scope.
Deny unauthorized data joins and provider export; check audit hashes and revoked permissions.
Learn reviewed privacy incidents, boundary test failures and source licensing changes.

A025.required_deliverable: lineage audit and blocked access list
A025.critical_failure: Private content or restricted license passed to cloud
A025.challenge_case: Poisoned public index with private record

cards.text: Map revenue segments, customers, pricing, cost structure and operating leverage; trace segment totals to consolidated results.
Differentiate actual reported revenue, TAM and management narrative; name alternative explanations.
Learn segment classification and thesis errors from later issuer filings.
Bridge volume, price, mix, FX and acquisitions; for subscriptions use cohorts, retention, CAC payback and gross margin only when disclosed.
Reconcile segment growth to consolidated revenue, label denominator and avoid deriving LTV from inconsistent churn.
Learn forecast misses by driver and independently checked cohort definitions.

A032.critical_failure: Confusing bookings with revenue or gross/net retention

cards.text: Compare rivals by substitutability, switching costs, pricing power, distribution and reinvestment economics. Seek counterexamples.
Require measurable evidence of durability such as margins or retention, not market share alone.
Learn moat erosion signals and contradictory evidence from future disclosures.

A033.critical_failure: Inferring moat from price performance alone
A033.challenge_case: High growth with customer churn and falling margins

cards.text: Trace capital allocation across capex, acquisitions, debt, dividends, buybacks and stock compensation; compare management promises with outcomes.
Reconcile share count, leverage and cash uses; separate gross repurchases from net dilution.
Learn repeated guidance misses and realized investment returns without personality inference.

A034.critical_failure: Ignoring dilution or claiming repurchases create value automatically
A034.challenge_case: Buyback offset by SBC and expensive acquisition

cards.text: Reconcile earnings with cash flow, working capital, revenue recognition, non-GAAP adjustments and related-party disclosures.
Flag unexplained accruals and restatements as investigation candidates, not accusations of fraud.
Learn accounting reconciliation errors and confirmed disclosure corrections.

A035.critical_failure: Treating adjusted earnings as audited cash flow

cards.text: Build historical FCFF bridge, explicit multi-year growth/margin/reinvestment scenarios, WACC and terminal economics; bridge EV to equity and diluted shares.
Use consistent nominal currency and tax assumptions; require WACC above perpetual growth and reinvestment consistent with terminal ROIC. Refuse financial firms under ordinary FCFF.
Learn independently scored forecast and assumption errors; no memory may change deterministic formula.

A041.critical_failure: Discount-rate mismatch or double counting debt
A041.challenge_case: Negative FCFF, net cash and invalid terminal growth

cards.text: Freeze observable price, share count, debt and cash; solve implied operating growth or margin with other assumptions held fixed.
Check root existence, uniqueness under assumed bracket and forward reconstruction of market price. Multiple solutions require a range.
Learn invalid brackets and implied growth infeasibility from reviewed reverse valuations.

A042.critical_failure: Reporting an unbracketed root or probability
A042.challenge_case: Nonmonotonic valuation and no feasible root

cards.text: Select comparable firms by economics, growth, capital intensity and accounting; normalize EV, earnings periods and currency.
Use same as-of price and fiscal basis; report median, spread, outliers and nonmeaningful multiples rather than fake comparability.
Learn peer-selection errors and forecast denominator revisions.

A043.challenge_case: Negative EBITDA and different lease accounting

cards.text: Define mutually exclusive terminal scenarios at a fixed horizon; distinguish touch probability, terminal probability and option-implied measures.
Probabilities sum to one; sensitivity to uncertain probabilities and downside. Do not treat a DCF as probability evidence.
Learn calibrated event frequencies and Brier scores only after outcomes resolve.

A044.required_deliverable: scenario assumptions and uncalibrated probability caveats
A044.critical_failure: Equating DCF value with likelihood of return

cards.text: Validate underlying price, strike, style, expiry, dividends, rate, multiplier and volatility inputs; compute conservative bounds before pricing.
Check no-arbitrage bounds, unit conversions and exercise conventions; missing volatility or style means abstain.
Learn pricing cross-check discrepancies and confirmed corporate-action adjustments.

A045.critical_failure: Claiming bounds are calibrated option price or Greeks
A045.challenge_case: American put early exercise and negative rates

cards.text: Assess normalized owner earnings, balance-sheet resilience, durable returns on capital and margin of safety.
Distinguish quality from price; penalize leverage, SBC and cyclical peak margins.
Learn thesis falsifiers from realized cash economics and price-independent business quality.

A051.required_deliverable: quality/value thesis and margin of safety
A051.critical_failure: Treating a low multiple as quality
A051.challenge_case: Cheap cyclical business with deteriorating cash flow

cards.text: Invert investment thesis, construct pre-mortem, check incentives, base rates and confirmation bias; seek disconfirming evidence.
List falsifiable claims and evidence that would change decision; do not simply echo bull case.
Learn recurring reasoning biases from independently adjudicated failed theses.
Map credit availability, risk premium, valuation dispersion and cyclical behavior; distinguish observations from regime judgment.
Use time-specific indicators and plausible alternative regimes; refuse exact turning-point claims.
Learn errors in cycle signals against later independently measured outcomes.

A053.critical_failure: Declaring a precise market turning point without evidence
A053.challenge_case: Easy credit followed by spread widening

cards.text: Translate narrative into addressable market, penetration, price, margins, reinvestment, risk and value.
Reconcile story assumptions to cash flows and terminal growth; explicitly stress market share and capital needs.
Learn narrative-to-number inconsistencies from audited valuations.

A054.critical_failure: Growth without reinvestment or impossible terminal economics

cards.text: Decompose growth and inflation exposure, rates, credit, currency and diversification; compare risk contributions rather than asset labels.
Use measured factor sensitivities and stressed correlations; no claim of guaranteed all-weather returns.
Learn regime mismatch and diversification failures from actual realized risk.

A055.challenge_case: Stocks and bonds fall together under inflation shock

cards.text: Compare nominal and real yield curves, duration, term premium and credit spreads using observed timestamps.
Distinguish policy rate changes from expectations, spread risk and curve moves; identify vintage and tenor.
Learn rate-scenario forecast errors and timestamp mismatches.

A061.critical_failure: Mixing real with nominal rate or vintage
A061.challenge_case: Curve inversion and revised inflation print

cards.text: Track funding conditions, credit spreads, central-bank balance-sheet and market liquidity with release dates.
Avoid equating a single liquidity measure with causality; test competing explanations and measurement lags.
Learn proxy failures against verified subsequent financial conditions.

A062.critical_failure: Equating central-bank assets with equity liquidity
A062.challenge_case: Liquidity expansion with tightening credit spreads

cards.text: Normalize inflation and growth releases by frequency, seasonal adjustment and vintage; compare surprise with prior expectations only when available.
Never use later revisions as contemporaneous data; distinguish level, rate and annualization.
Learn release-specific forecast errors using actual first-release observations.

A063.critical_failure: Using latest revised GDP in historical signal
A063.challenge_case: Initial release differs from final revision

cards.text: Map currency pair orientation, base/quote, commodity contract maturity, carry and cross-asset exposure.
Reconcile FX conversion and return convention; avoid spot/futures roll confusion.
Learn convention and rollover errors from independently reconciled data.

A064.critical_failure: Inverting FX pair or ignoring denomination
A064.challenge_case: USD/CAD shock on CAD investor portfolio

cards.text: Classify regimes using predeclared lagged features and thresholds; compare transition stability across windows.
No future labels, no ex-post threshold tuning; report ambiguous or unsupported regimes.
Learn confusion matrix and transition failures on separately locked samples.

A065.critical_failure: Lookahead or claiming future regime prediction

cards.text: State economic factor hypothesis, construction, universe, lag, neutralization and baseline before experiment.
Audit survivorship, turnover and multiplicity; rank IC alone cannot justify capital allocation.
Learn all completed and failed factor trials from registered outcomes.

A071.critical_failure: Optimizing holdout or reporting correlation as alpha

cards.text: Audit feature availability, label horizon, grouped temporal splits, purge and embargo, preprocessing fit scope.
Reject target proxies, revised data and cross-fold scaler leakage; preserve exact train/test IDs.
Learn discovered leakage patterns only from reproducible negative controls.

A072.critical_failure: Train label published after test start
A072.challenge_case: Overlapping forward returns and revised fundamentals

cards.text: Freeze event definition, first public timestamp, estimation window, event window and expected-return model.
Correct for clustered events and confounders; preserve negative results and overlapping samples.
Learn event-study false positives and timestamp failures from independent replications.

A073.critical_failure: Post-event timestamp leakage or uncorrected multiple tests

cards.text: Document alternative-data collection rights, coverage, missingness, sampling, lag and economic rationale.
Reject unauthorized data, personally identifying signals and unreconciled source changes; compare conventional baseline.
Learn verified coverage breaks and incremental-information failures.

A074.challenge_case: Backfilled vendor dataset with restricted rights

cards.text: Freeze rolling training windows, label availability, locked holdout and transaction-cost model; preserve delistings.
Check independent replay, leakage, costs, turnover, trial counts and drawdown. No backfill or winner-only reporting.
Learn trial failures and differences between simulated and independent replay.

A075.critical_failure: Test dates shared across train and test

cards.text: Reconcile all accounts, signed positions, NAV, FX, factor decomposition and ETF overlap.
Compute gross/net concentration and cluster exposures without cross-account collateral assumptions.
Learn independently reconciled exposure breaks; private notes never cloud.

A081.critical_failure: Double counting ETF assets or cross-account collateral
A081.challenge_case: QQQ and leveraged ETF overlapping holdings

cards.text: Compare historical simulation, EWMA, filtered residual and GARCH-t tail forecasts; separate VaR from ES.
Use coverage, independence, joint severity diagnostics and stress scenarios; nonrejection is not model proof.
Learn realized tail exceedances and model calibration failures with frozen forecast history.
Use credible scenario probabilities and net payoff distribution; optimize expected log growth subject to total portfolio constraints.
Reject unknown probability, tail loss or account equity; show fractional Kelly and sensitivity rather than automatic size.
Learn independently evaluated probability and realized payoff errors.

A083.challenge_case: Small apparent edge with probability uncertainty

cards.text: Apply joint price, FX, correlation, liquidity and maintenance-margin shocks; revalue options or use conservative bounds.
Report per-account liquidity separately, worst scenario, model assumptions and hedge basis risk.
Learn actual stress discrepancies and hedge slippage from reconciled records.

A084.critical_failure: Netting registered assets against margin deficit
A084.challenge_case: Volatility and FX shocks with separate accounts

cards.text: Identify account type, tax residence, date, ACB, contribution room, FX and proposed action; check authoritative current rules.
Do not assume capital loss treatment, contribution room or tax rate from stale balances; escalate ambiguous cases.
Learn only independently confirmed rules and account-specific exceptions in private memory.

A085.critical_failure: Invented tax savings or unverified eligibility

cards.text: Construct research-only order proposal from approved target and verified quote, tick/lot, cash, account limits and opportunity cost.
Default WAIT absent mandate, independent risk and authorization; proposal is not submission.
Learn rejected proposal reasons and simulated implementation shortfalls.

A091.challenge_case: Unvalidated proposal with missing decision provenance

cards.text: Measure spreads, depth, turnover, venue, participation and price impact with explicit units and timestamps.
Separate quoted spread, expected impact and realized shortfall; do not extrapolate unsupported liquidity.
Learn observed execution cost errors from reconciled fills.

A092.critical_failure: Equating spread with actual execution costs
A092.challenge_case: Thin market with crossed or stale quotes

cards.text: Reconcile account NAV, maintenance margin, excess liquidity, buying power, FX and positions; stress each account.
Do not confuse cash with buying power or assume margin offsets across accounts. Block missing timestamps.
Learn broker-versus-model margin discrepancies only from verified snapshots.

A093.critical_failure: Treating buying power as cash or collateral across accounts
A093.challenge_case: Margin deficit with unrelated registered surplus

cards.text: Join intended orders to broker client ID, fills, cancellations, partial executions and balances.
Reconcile quantity, fees and status; uncertain order outcomes block retry.
Learn repeat fill and reconciliation breaks from confirmed broker records.

A094.critical_failure: Missing, duplicate or modified fills accepted
A094.challenge_case: Partial fill replay with fee mismatch

cards.text: Check exact approved mandate, account identity, preflight risk, order intent, expiry and immutable authorization.
Deny real orders by design; never infer permission from model recommendation or paper status.
Learn false-denial diagnostics only; memory cannot grant permissions.

A095.critical_failure: Any live order route or policy mutation
A095.challenge_case: Malicious tool request during model output

cards.text: Independently build strongest bear thesis, alternative causes and disconfirming evidence before reading consensus conclusion.
Separate plausible downside from allegation; preserve falsifiers and contradictions without forcing agreement.
Learn which downside drivers materialized using later verified filings.

A101.critical_failure: Repeating bull case with cosmetic risks
A101.challenge_case: Overvalued high-growth issuer with contradictory disclosure

cards.text: Independently re-read raw filing evidence, reconstruct calculations, compare claims with exact cited spans.
Reject mismatched issuer, period, units and unsupported entailment; never grade based only on citation existence.
Learn independently graded source and arithmetic errors without benchmark leakage.

A102.critical_failure: Accepting fabricated citation or unsupported calculation
A102.challenge_case: Correct citation but incorrect EBITDA bridge

cards.text: Specify causal hypothesis, confounders, selection mechanism and null; compare controls, placebo and robustness checks.
Distinguish association from identification; no causal claim from correlation or backtest alone.
Learn failed identification assumptions from independent replication.

A103.challenge_case: Simpson paradox and hidden factor exposure

cards.text: Freeze forecast event, horizon, probability and baseline; resolve against measured outcome and exact evidence.
Compute Brier and calibration by bins with sample sizes; account for overlapping forecasts and censored outcomes.
Learn only resolved forecast errors; proposals never automatically change models.

A104.critical_failure: Comparing overlapping forecasts as independent or hindsight labels
A104.challenge_case: Sparse bins and forecasts with unresolved outcomes

cards.text: Generate narrowly scoped Skill change proposal from verified recurring failure; freeze old/new versions and benchmark.
Register all attempts, independent tests, costs, adverse outcomes and rollback; no self-certification or auto-promotion.
Learn failed improvement experiments and reviewer feedback without rewriting policy.

A105.challenge_case: Prompt challenger improves training but fails holdout
